Add layer

Source: R/fct_mapgl.R
mapgl_add_layer.Rd

Add object as a layer to a mapgl object.

Usage

mapgl_add_layer(map, x, visibility = "visible", before_id = NULL)

Arguments

map

A map object created by the mapboxgl or maplibre function.

x

[new_tile()], [new_feature()], [new_cost()], [new_lock()], or [new_solution()] object.

visibility

Whether this layer is displayed.

before_id

The name of the layer that this layer appears "before", allowing you to insert layers below other layers in your basemap (e.g. labels).

Details

Layers are added with [mapgl::add_fill_layer()].

See also

Other mapping: get_paint_parameters(), has_mapbox_token(), map_project(), mapgl_add_source(), mapgl_clear_layer(), mapgl_layer_id(), mapgl_source_id(), mapgl_source_layer_id(), mapgl_source_url()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# simulate spatial data
sim_data <- simulate_spatial_data()

# create objects
dataset <- create_dataset_from_sf(sim_data)
tile <- create_tile_from_sf(sim_data)
cost <- new_cost(
  name = "cost",
  zone = "Science",
  weight = 0.1,
  layer = new_layer(
    column = "feat_1",
    total = 500,
    dataset = dataset,
    tile = tile,
    legend = simulate_continuous_legend(),
    provenance = simulate_provenance(),
    details = "extra info"
  )
)

# create mapbox map
map <- mapgl::mapboxgl()

# add source for tile object
map <- mapgl_add_source(map, tile)

# add layer for cost object
map <- mapgl_add_layer(map, cost)

# display map
# \dontrun{
print(map)
# }
}
